list.title: Communic Flow
list.descProject: Communic Flow is a multi-level organizational dashboard designed to modernize institutional communication. It connects organizations, their affiliates, and members through a centralized platform offering information management, role-based access control, event planning, claim management, real-time messaging, and Power BI reporting. Initially developed for the National Chamber of the Pharmaceutical Industry (CNIP), the application addresses real needs for coordination, transparency, and rapid information flow across complex ecosystems.

description.title: Main Features
points: Centralized institutional information across organizations and affiliates
Complete hierarchical structure: Super Administrator → Organizations → Members
Advanced claim management: creation, tracking, and responses
Real-time messaging with Socket.IO (groups and individual chats)
Event planning and scheduling
Advanced user, role, and permission management
Management of organizations and their affiliates
Power BI integration for interactive analytics and decision-making

devopsProcess.title: DevOps Process
steps: Implementation of a complete CI/CD architecture using Jenkins
Automated continuous integration for both frontend and backend
Application containerization using Docker with image storage in Nexus Repository
Automated code quality analysis with SonarQube and strict Quality Gates
Security and vulnerability scanning using OWASP Dependency-Check
Application and pipeline monitoring via Prometheus
Performance metrics visualization using Grafana
Automated deployment pipeline to the VPS with artifact management

list.title: Communic Flow — Version 2
list.descProject: Communic Flow v2 represents the redesigned and upgraded version of the multi-level organizational platform, now rebuilt with a modern microservices architecture. Messaging is fully isolated as an independent service powered by GraphQL and Redis for inter-service communication. The authentication system has been enhanced with secure HTTP-Only cookies, Google OAuth 2.0, Cloudflare Turnstile to block spam, and a complete two-factor authentication flow. Company creation is optimized with automated VIES validation for EU companies and ZIP-based address autofill. Backend security has been significantly reinforced, and real-time messaging performance has been improved to support future features such as voice and video calling.

description.title: Main Features
points: Microservices-based architecture with isolated real-time messaging service
GraphQL-powered messaging engine for optimized queries and subscriptions
Redis used for inter-service communication and event streaming
Secure authentication using HTTP-Only cookies for JWT tokens
New Google OAuth 2.0 login flow
Cloudflare Turnstile anti-spam protection
Full two-factor authentication (2FA) system
Improved company creation process with VIES automatic EU validation
ZIP code based automatic address detection
Enhanced backend security with stricter validations and improved token handling
Optimized instant messaging with better performance and scalability
Voice call and video call features under development
Upcoming improvements for user-interaction linkage across organizations
New UI experience including Dark Mode

Progressive rollout strategy to support new messaging features like voice and video

list.title: Kickoff Sports Platform
list.descProject: Kickoff Sports is a dual-platform sports facility management system connecting stadium owners with football enthusiasts. The platform consists of two specialized applications: a client app for players to discover and book sports fields, and a stadium management app for facility owners to manage their venues, schedules, and bookings. Built with modern web technologies, it streamlines the entire process from field discovery to reservation confirmation.

description.title: Main Features
points: Dual-platform architecture: Client app for players and Stadium app for venue owners
Real-time field availability and instant booking system
Stadium management dashboard with booking calendar and revenue analytics
Multi-field venue support with individual field scheduling
Secure payment integration for online reservations
Automated booking confirmations and notifications
User account management with booking history
Stadium profile customization with photos, amenities, and pricing
Location-based search for nearby sports facilities
Rating and review system for stadiums
Responsive design optimized for desktop and mobile devices

list.title: Creation of a mobile application for booking medical appointments online with a doctor
list.descProject: ALLO DOCTOR, an innovative solution, offers the possibility to book medical appointments online through a sophisticated mobile application developed with advanced React Native technology. The robustness of our infrastructure relies on a backend developed with Express.js, supported by the power of MongoDB as a database. This approach ensures a smooth user experience, efficient data management, and a quick response to requests, thus elevating the level of quality and professionalism of our online medical booking service.

list.title: Creation of a SOAP API using Spring Boot projects
list.descProject: Creating a SOAP API with Spring Boot provides a powerful and efficient approach to web application development. Using this robust platform, we can design a modern and scalable SOAP API, facilitating communication between different systems. Spring Boot simplifies the process by providing default configuration and built-in features, enabling rapid implementation and optimal management of web services. This approach, combining the flexibility of Spring Boot and SOAP communication standards, ensures seamless and secure integration, meeting the most demanding API development needs.

list.title: Creation of a mobile application for organizing, booking seats for trips and hikes with an online guide
list.descProject: An innovative mobile application that allows users to select tourist routes offered by expert guides. In addition to allowing tourists to choose their favorite destinations and create custom itineraries, the application consists of two parts: a dynamic user interface developed with the Ionic framework for the front end, and a robust server-side infrastructure created with Express.js and MongoDB for the back end. It also features the ability to choose from a list of available guides, view their personal profiles, and read reviews left by other tourists.

list.title: Creation of a responsive web application for digital art: ARTVERSE
list.descProject: Our project is to create a platform dedicated to digital art, providing artists with a space to showcase their creations. This initiative aligns with the growing trend of online platforms that facilitate communication, information sharing, and collaboration in the artistic field, while opening new perspectives for cultural promotion.

desc.title: Introduction to Design Patterns
desc.description: Design Patterns are proven solutions to recurring problems in software development. This article explores their importance for writing maintainable and performant code.

desc.title: The Singleton Pattern
desc.description: Ensures a class has only one instance and provides a global access point. Ideal for centralizing important features in your application.

desc.title: Observer Pattern
desc.description: Allows an object to notify multiple observers of state changes. Perfect for managing events in a reactive application.

desc.title: Factory Pattern
desc.description: Delegates object creation to dedicated classes, facilitating dependency management and code maintenance.

desc.title: MVC Architecture
desc.description: The MVC model organizes the application into Model, View, and Controller, and combines effectively with design patterns to build robust applications.

desc.title: Conclusion
desc.description: Design Patterns improve code quality and maintainability. Experiment with them to transform your development approach.
